## Question

What hypothesis or limitation should be examined?

Which step in [the research roadmap](https://github.com/nutrifit-health/craving-engine/blob/main/docs/research-roadmap.md) does this address? Is this interpretation, reproduction, exploration or independent confirmation?

## Proposed comparison

Which baseline, data split and operating constraint would make the comparison informative?

State the success and failure criteria before running the experiment. What is available in the frozen bundle, and what new inputs or implementation are needed?

## Evidence and uncertainty

Link to the relevant result, source revision or primary research. Explain what would support or reject the hypothesis.

Do not include private health records, company documents or substantial original code here. The code assignment process is described in [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/nutrifit-health/craving-engine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); an issue is not an assignment.
